content: Prisma 7 Json fields: schema uses 'Json?' for nullable. Client: pass plain JS objects/arrays directly to create/update. Read back and cast: 'as Prisma.JsonArray' or 'as Prisma.JsonObject'. Null distinction: Prisma.JsonNull (stores JSON null), Prisma.DbNull (stores DB NULL), Prisma.AnyNull (filter only). For a worker updating an existing job: prisma.job.update({ where: { id }, data: { transcript: segments as Prisma.JsonArray, status: 'DONE' } }). JSON fields are typed as 'Prisma.JsonValue' by default.
